instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang over your knees.
3. Lower the bar by letting your wrists drop as far as they go.
4. Lift the bar by extending your wrists upward as high as possible.
5. Keep your forearms pressed to your thighs the whole time.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your forearms still and move only at the wrists.
2. Use a controlled tempo on the way down.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Use a light load to keep the wrists pain-free.
name: Barbell wrist extension on knees

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Keep your legs as straight as possible.
3. Bend at the hips and reach your hands toward your toes.
4. Hold the stretch for a few seconds.
5. Stand back up under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge from the hips, not the lower back.
2. Move slowly with no bouncing.
3. Breathe deeply to relax into the stretch.
4. Bend the knees slightly if your hamstrings are tight.
name: Basic toe touch

instructions:
1. Start in a quarter squat with feet shoulder-width apart and hands as if holding a ball.
2. Drive up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles to jump.
3. Reach your arms overhead as if shooting.
4. Land softly on the balls of your feet, then your whole foot.
5. Bend your knees to absorb the landing and return to the squat.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive power from your legs and hips, not your arms.
2. Land soft with bent knees to protect your joints.
3. Keep your chest up through the jump.
4. Exhale as you jump.
name: Basketball shot jump

instructions:
1. Sit at the lat pulldown machine with the thigh pad set against your legs.
2. Grasp the bar with a wide overhand grip.
3. Keep your torso upright and tilt your head slightly forward.
4. Pull the bar down behind your neck while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Slowly return the bar to the top with arms fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull with your back, not your arms.
2. Avoid pulling the bar too low to protect the neck and shoulders.
3. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.
4. Keep the movement slow and controlled.
name: Behind neck lat pull down machine

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and the band under your feet.
2. Hold the band ends at your shoulders with elbows bent and the band behind your neck.
3. Brace your core.
4. Press the band straight overhead until your arms are extended.
5. Lower the band back behind your neck under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core to stay stable.
2. Press in a straight line overhead.
3. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
4. Only press as low as your shoulder mobility allows.
name: Behind neck press Resistance band cable
